text: No, the property has not lost tree cover since 2021. While there was a small loss (0.4 ha) recorded in 2021, this was in patches under 0.5 ha, which are excluded from event counts due to the minimum event area threshold of 0.5 ha. No further tree-cover loss events have been observed since then. The most recent data (2025) confirms no additional losses beyond the baseline date of December 31, 2020. The asset had tree cover in 2000 but none by 2020, with all significant losses occurring before 2021.
